A '''datacron''' or '''data holocron''' was a type of [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that could be accessed by non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. They were mainly used to store encrypted data. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] stored encrypted information in a datacron and hid it on [[Rekkiad]] in the [[Twin Spears]] along with [[Mandalore's Mask]]. [[Canderous Ordo]] and a redeemed [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] later returned with other [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to take Mandalore's Mask back.

==Behind the scenes==
Datacrons are small cubes hidden throughout the universe of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. They grant bonus points to a single stat or a matrix shard. Datacrons glow and emit a pillar of colored light into the sky making them more visible. They also make an ambient sound that can be heard when in close vicinity of a datacron.
